'''Ortosin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Ortosin was sent by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darth Skotia]] to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to issue an ultimatum to [[Darth Zash|Zash's]] new [[Darth Nox|apprentice]]. Ortosin threatened the apprentice not to travel to the Empire's [[Kaas City|capital city]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] but the apprentice refused to be intimidated. Having decided to introduce Ortosin to the [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Khem Val]], one of Ortosin's cohorts became frightened as he heard about the Dashade's dangerous nature of devouring [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] and spit out their bones. Ortosin in return [[Duel in the Sith Academy|attacked]] the apprentice along with two other thugs but was defeated and [[Death/Legends|killed]].
